data.narrative:
Sanctuary AI, a Series C robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $130M cumulatively, is evaluated against a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ). The peer set—anchored by companies including Exotec ($2.0B Series D), Generalist AI ($2.0B Series B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), and Dexterity ($1.6B Series B)—spans adjacent stages and the same sector, establishing a market range of $1.0B to $2.0B with a median of $1.6B.

Two triangulation methods apply. The stage-progression approach uses the $130M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, implying a valuation of $221M. The peer-median method directly benchmarks against the 7-peer cohort, yielding a $1.6B implied valuation. These two methods produce a wide range reflecting both early-stage capital efficiency and sector-peer positioning.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $188M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $936M. The gap between stage-progression and peer-median methods reflects uncertainty around whether Sanctuary AI commands a premium or discount relative to the robotics cohort, contingent on proprietary technology differentiation, revenue traction, and path to next capital event. Data on revenue, unit economics, and customer concentration would narrow this range materially.
